descriptorExport.full: correlateAi(events, mappings?) -> AiCorrelationResult { claims, overlapGroups, alternatives, branches, fractions }
descriptorExport.descriptor: aiCorrelationDescriptor (id correlation/ai, kind correlation, readiness ready) in descriptor.ts
descriptorExport.mappings: CorrelationMapping { key: 'session:<sessionId>', value: '<branch>' } forces a strong conversation->branch join

sourceProbe: None needed: pure correlation over normalized envelopes. Payload shapes were read from the in-tree producers (cursor-hooks, cursor-local-db, cursor-usage-export, cursor-cli) and decoded with Effect Schema views.

checks.result: 0 diagnostics in B26 files; the non-zero exit comes from other owners' files at 14:20

supportedFields: overlapGroups (collapsed on a shared requestId/turn key, preferred by AI_SOURCE_PRECEDENCE; alternative for aggregate ledgers; unresolved for id-less claims within 60s of another source)
fractions.units and fractions.amounts: strong/provisional/unallocated/unresolved/total and allocatedFraction (null plus a reason when total is 0)
gaps: Time-window placement uses the min/max span of branch events with full context (branch, worktree and head). It is only provisional and does not use B27 interval unions.
Amounts are read only from payload.measurements[], payload.tokens{}, payload.charge and payload.costUsd with costLedger. Raw hook usage with semanticsVerified=false adds no amounts.
Estimated amounts stay under separate 'estimated:' keys. The module does no cumulative differencing (that is B30).
Proof uses fixtures only. The module is not yet registered by A02/A07 and has not run against a live Cursor store in this node.
